title: MeterRouter: Budget-Aware Dynamic Routing for Multi-Agent Systems
title_zh: MeterRouter：面向多智能体系统的预算感知动态路由
abstract_en: Multi-agent systems (MAS) built on large language models (LLMs) outperform single-agent systems, but inter-agent communication incurs substantial token overhead. While assigning a large LLM to every agent is common, it results in inefficient resource utilization, leaving the system far from the Pareto frontier. The cost of answering a query is set jointly by how many agents are recruited, the role and LLM assigned to each, and communication topology among them. Most existing routers treat cost only implicitly rather than as an explicit optimization constraint. A fixed accuracy-cost preference also cannot express how much a caller is willing to pay for a particular query. We introduce MeterRouter, a budget-aware dynamic router that incrementally synthesizes a collaboration graph by selecting each agent's role, LLM, incoming connections, and termination conditioned on the query and a per-query monetary budget. We initialize the router by imitating successful execution graphs, then jointly refine its decisions with a variant of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) whose reward favors correct answers and penalizes spending and budget overruns. Across five benchmarks and a three-tier LLM pool, MeterRouter is (1) accurate, achieving performance comparable to the strongest MAS; (2) economical, reaching that accuracy at 82% lower cost than the strongest MAS router and extending the accuracy-cost frontier beyond the ceiling of single-agent systems; and (3) controllable, adapting its spending to the specified budget while rarely exceeding it.
abstract_zh: 基于大语言模型（LLM）的多智能体系统（MAS）通常比单智能体系统更准确，但智能体之间的通信会产生大量额外的 token 开销。每次查询的成本由智能体数量、各自的角色与所用模型，以及通信拓扑共同决定，而现有路由器大多未将成本作为显式约束。MeterRouter 根据查询内容及其指定的货币预算，逐步构建协作图：选择每个智能体的角色、LLM 和入边，并决定何时停止扩展。训练先模仿成功的执行图，再用 Group Relative Policy Optimization（GRPO）的变体联合优化这些决策，奖励正确答案，同时惩罚支出和超预算行为。在五个基准和包含三个档位的 LLM 池上，MeterRouter 达到了与最强多智能体系统相当的准确率，成本比最强多智能体路由器低 82%。它还将准确率–成本前沿推至单智能体系统的准确率上限之外，并能随查询预算调整支出，且很少超支。
key_points_zh: 将每次查询的货币预算作为显式输入，而不是对所有查询采用固定的准确率–成本权衡。
逐步构建协作图，联合决定智能体的角色、所用 LLM、接收哪些上游智能体的消息，以及何时停止扩展。
先模仿成功的执行图，再用 GRPO 变体优化答案正确性、支出和超预算惩罚。
在五个基准上达到与最强多智能体系统相当的准确率，成本比最强多智能体路由器低 82%，且很少超出指定预算。

agent-harness-evolution.reason: 核心贡献是用成功执行图初始化可复用的多智能体路由策略，再根据答案正确性、开销和超预算反馈更新策略，而非仅采用固定编排。摘要报告了与最强多智能体路由器在相近准确率下的量化成本比较，但未给出消融结果或明确的预算适用边界。
